# Korea Construction Trading Co., Ltd. (KCT / 한국건설트레이딩)

> KCT is a Seoul-based B2B supplier and exporter of DOWSIL™ (Dow) silicone sealants and related construction materials: architectural/curtain wall, structural glazing, GMP/clean-room, civil engineering, insulating glass, specialty products and primers. Wholesale and export inquiries welcome.

- Contact: sales@kconstrade.com · +82-10-8939-0284 (phone/WhatsApp)
- Address: 10 Chungmin-ro, Songpa-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
- Languages: Korean (https://kconstrade.com/ko), English (https://kconstrade.com/en), Japanese (https://kconstrade.com/ja)
- Sitemap: https://kconstrade.com/sitemap.xml

## DOWSIL™ silicone sealants and foams for industrial, appliance and maintenance (Selection Guide)
English and Korean edition of Dow's Selection Guide (Form No. 80-8283-01-0922 S2D): 38 products with specifications, adhesion ratings, surface preparation and application. Full plain-text version: https://kconstrade.com/llms-full.txt

- [Selection guide hub](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial) · [한국어](https://kconstrade.com/ko/technical/industrial)
- [Original PDF](https://kconstrade.com/docs/dow-silicone-sealants-foams-industrial-assembly.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ Silicone Sealants – Benefits and Why Silicones](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/overview): Temperature stability, weather and chemical resistance, bond strength, electrical properties, low flammability; why silicones outperform organics.
- [Which Silicone? RTV, Heat Cure, Hot Melt, One-Part, Two-Part and Foams](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/which-silicone): The six formulation options (RTV, heat cure, hot-melt, one-part, two-part, silicone foams) and the basic chemistry of silicone sealants.
- [Table I: Sealant Chemistries – Acetoxy, Alkoxy, Oxime, Hot Melt, Platinum](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/sealant-chemistries): Compare acid-cure acetoxy and neutral-cure alkoxy, oxime, two-part alkoxy, hot-melt and platinum foam chemistries by cure, green strength, adhesion, shelf life and clarity.
- [Table II: Acetoxy Sealants – DOWSIL™ 730 FS, 732, 734, 786, XIAMETER™ and AP](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/acetoxy-sealants): Specifications, applications and primerless adhesion of eight one-part acetoxy silicone sealants and coatings.
- [High-Temperature Acetoxy Sealants – DOWSIL™ 736 (315°C) and Q3-1566 (350°C)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/high-temperature-sealants): Heat-resistant sealants for ovens, boilers, flues and heating equipment with service temperatures to 260–275°C (315–350°C intermittent).
- [Table III: Alkoxy Neutral-Cure Sealants – DOWSIL™ 739, 748, 3145, 7091–7094, AS 7096N, 3559](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/alkoxy-neutral-cure-sealants): Nine one-part neutral-cure sealants and adhesives: plastic adhesive, electrical, Mil Spec, high green strength, flowable and low-modulus grades.
- [Table IV: Two-Part Alkoxy and One-Part Oxime Sealants – DOWSIL™ EA-2626, Q3-3526, SILASTIC™ Q3-3636, DOWSIL™ 1080](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/two-part-and-oxime-sealants): Fast-curing two-component neutral-cure adhesives for ovens, hobs and headlamps, plus DOWSIL™ 1080 one-part oxime sealant.
- [Table V: Hot-Melt Neutral-Cure Silicone Assembly Sealants – DOWSIL™ HM-2500, HM-2510, HM-2515, HM-2600](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/hot-melt-sealants): Instant-adhesion, 100% silicone hot-melt sealants for OEM assembly, bonding, sealing and gasketing, with green strength, SAFT and primerless adhesion data.
- [Table VI: Two-Part Addition-Cure Silicone Foams – SILASTIC™ 8257, DOWSIL™ 3-8209, 3-8219 RF, 3-8259 RF](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/silicone-foams): Formed-in-place compression gaskets: viscosity, snap time, density, hardness and cell structure of four silicone foam families.
- [Surface Preparation for Silicone Sealants](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/surface-preparation): How to clean, degrease and abrade surfaces, which solvents to use, and when to use plasma, corona, UV or flame pretreatment.
- [Table VII: Primers, Adhesion Promoters and Cleaners – DOWSIL™ PR-1200, 1200 OS, 1203, PR-2260, DS-1000, DS-2025, R41](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/primers-and-cleaners): When and how to prime, primer cure times (5–30 minutes), and DOWSIL™ primers and cleaners for cured and uncured silicone.
- [Sealant Application, Cure Time, Compatibility and Cleanup](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/application-and-cure): Skin-over in 5–10 minutes, cure depth of about 1/8" in 24 hours, tooling, acetic-acid corrosion, platinum inhibitors, sealant removal and safety information.
- [Product Selector – Compare All DOWSIL™ Industrial, Appliance and Maintenance Sealants](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/product-selector): One-page comparison of all 38 products by chemistry, temperature range, cure, hardness, tensile and elongation, plus a requirement-to-product quick guide.
- [Handling Precautions, Limited Warranty and Contact](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/industrial/notice-and-contact): Safety data sheet requirement, Dow limited warranty information and how to reach Dow and KCT.

## Silicone Basics Training: Chemistry, Manufacturing, Properties and Applications
Complete silicone fundamentals in 11 pages: history and nomenclature, direct process, silane, resin, polymer, emulsion, LSR/RTV/HCR rubber, molecular characteristics, properties, applications, usage methods and data appendices (Korean original with English translation). Inquiries: Korea Construction Trading (KCT), sales@kconstrade.com, +82 10-8939-0284. Full plain-text version: https://kconstrade.com/llms-full.txt

- [Hub](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics) · [한국어](https://kconstrade.com/ko/technical/basics)
- [Original PDF](https://kconstrade.com/docs/silicone-basics-training-ko.pdf)
- [What Is Silicone? Overview, History and Nomenclature](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/overview-history): Silicone as a polymer material made from SiO₂ (sand): history from 1824 to the first DC-4 grease, and the meaning of silica, silicon, silane, silicate and siloxane.
- [How Silicone Is Made: Direct Process and Synthesis Mechanism](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/manufacturing-process): From sand to silicon metal to chlorosilane, hydrolysis, condensation and end blocking: the overall process chart and basic synthesis mechanism.
- [Silane and Silicone Resin Production](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/silane-and-resin): Functional-group classes, Si metal production at 2600°C, the two Direct Process routes, the product distribution table of methylchlorosilanes, and silicone resin (silsesquioxane).
- [Silicone Polymer and Emulsion Production](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/polymer-and-emulsion): Polymer manufacturing steps, catalyst selection, condensation and equilibration reactions, hydrolysis of dichlorosilane, and mechanical vs. emulsion-polymerization silicone emulsions.
- [Silicone Rubber: LSR, RTV, SWBE, Dispersion, HCR and Silica](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/silicone-rubber): Raw materials and composition of liquid silicone rubber (2-part, vinyl/hydride platinum cure), RTV (1-part, hydroxy-terminated), water-based elastomer, solvent dispersion, HCR, and silica fillers.
- [Characteristics of the Silicone Molecule: Si–O Backbone and CH₃ Side Groups](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/molecular-characteristics): Why silicone differs from organic polymers: free rotation, bond strength, bond angle and length of Si–O versus C–C and C–O, and the Si–O inorganic backbone combined with CH₃ organic side chains.
- [Chemical and Physical Properties and Functional Groups of Silicone](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/properties-and-functional-groups): List of strengths and weaknesses of silicone, functional-group effects (phenyl, fluoro, amino, vinyl …) and the link between molecular features and applications.
- [Silicone Applications by Industry and Product Forms (Fluid, Gum, Resin, Rubber)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/applications-and-forms): Industries using silicone — aerospace to textiles — and the product forms: fluid, gum, resin, compound, silane, emulsion, rubber (RTV, LSR, HCR, SWBE, dispersion).
- [How Each Silicone Product Is Used: Silane, Resin, Fluid, LSR, RTV](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/usage-methods): Typical use of silane coupling agents/primers, resin paint additives, emulsified fluids for textiles, LSR fabric coating and RTV cartridges.
- [Appendix: Bond Energies, Nomenclature, Surface Energy, Viscosity–Molecular Weight, Heat and Permeability Data](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/appendix-data): Appendices 1–9: Si–X vs C–X bond-cleavage energies, M/D/T/Q nomenclature, polymer surface energies, PDMS viscosity vs. Mw, thermal stability, heat-ageing of rubbers, water-vapour and oxygen permeability.
- [Supplementary Technical Notes and References (Beyond the Original Document)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/basics/supplement-references): Notes added by KCT from public references: the Müller–Rochow direct process, Si–O bond behaviour, spread in published PDMS Tg values, and guidance for selecting DOWSIL products — not part of the original training PDF.

- [Table 1: Application Overview – Solutions for Films and Specialty Tapes](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/application-overview-table): Which DOWSIL™ PSA, mica binder, solventless PSA and SYL-OFF™ release coating is suggested for masking, electrical, splicing, protective-film, double-sided tape, label and liner applications.
- [Table 2: Product Specifications and Typical Performance Properties (Viscosity, Adhesion, Tack, High-Temperature Hold)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/product-specifications-table): Cure system, viscosity, non-volatile content, adhesion, probe tack and high-temperature hold/shear for 41 DOWSIL™ PSAs, mica binders and solventless adhesives.
- [Features/Benefits and Typical Applications of Each DOWSIL™ PSA](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/features-and-applications): Features, benefits and typical applications for each DOWSIL™ PSA, mica binder and solventless adhesive: masking, plating, splicing, electrical tapes, protective films, low Si-migration and mica tape binders.
- [Primer, Crosslinkers, Anchorage Additives and Fluorosilicone Release Coatings](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/primers-crosslinkers-release-coatings): DOWSIL™ 7499 PSA Primer, SYL-OFF™ crosslinkers (SL 7028, 7678, Q2-7560, SL 7561), anchorage additives (SL 9250, 297, 397) and fluorosilicone release coatings (Q2-7785, 7786, 7792, 7795, 7798, 7555).
- [Release of Silicone PSAs: Fluorosilicone Release Coatings and Table 3 (Transfer Coating / Direct Cast)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/release-coating-and-transfer-coating): How SYL-OFF™ fluorosilicone release coatings give consistent release from silicone PSAs, how to create differential release (1.2–2.5 ratio), and Table 3 of recommended PSA / release-coating combinations.
- [Processing and Curing Considerations (2024): Platinum and Peroxide Cure, Oven Dusting, Anchorage](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/processing-and-curing-2024): Updated processing guidance: platinum cure (catalyst, six-hour bath life, 80 °C cure), peroxide cure (0.5–3.0% benzoyl peroxide, solvent removal 65–93 °C, heat cure), oven dusting, anchorage and the adhesion-vs-tack graph.
- [What Changed: 2006 Dow Corning PSA Guide vs. 2024 Dow Silicone PSA Guide](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/guide-2006-vs-2024-changes): Side-by-side comparison of the two Dow guides hosted here: product range, naming, platinum bath life, high-temperature hold values and new auxiliary materials.
- [More Options for Your Business, Global Support and Safety Notice](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/more-options-and-dow-support): Auxiliary materials, custom formulation and application support from Dow, global presence, product safety information and the notice that applies to all values in the guide.
- [High-Performance Silicone PSAs: Product Line and How to Select](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/overview-how-to-select): Dow Corning silicone pressure sensitive adhesives: gums and resins in xylene/toluene, platinum and peroxide cure, primers, Syl-Off Q2-7785 release coating, and the selection steps.
- [Silicone PSA Selection Flow Chart](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/selection-flow-chart): Decision flow: solvent handling, food contact, tape or laminating construction, cure temperature and service-temperature range, with the recommended Dow Corning PSA for each branch.
- [Peroxide-Cure vs. Platinum-Cure Silicone PSAs (Table 1)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/platinum-vs-peroxide): Components, bath life, cure temperature and oven requirements, benefits and drawbacks of platinum-cure and peroxide-cure silicone PSAs.
- [Silicone PSA Product Descriptions and Typical Performance (Table 2)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/product-descriptions): Features, typical applications and high-temperature hold/shear of 2013, 7657, 7659, 280A, 282, 7355, 7356, 7358, Q2-7406, Q2-7566 and Q2-7735 adhesives.
- [Relative Tack, Adhesion and High-Temperature Hold (Figures 1–3)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/tack-adhesion-hold-charts): Polyken probe tack, relative adhesion and comparative high-temperature hold (cohesive strength) of the Dow Corning silicone PSAs, with the expected value ranges.
- [Processing Considerations: Substrate and Adhesive Thickness Effects (Figures 4–5)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/processing-thickness-effects): Coating with toluene/xylene dilution, coat-weight control, blending peroxide-cure PSAs, and how backing and adhesive thickness change tack and adhesion.
- [Platinum-Cure Process: Catalyst, Bath Life and Cure Speed](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/platinum-cure-process): Syl-Off 4000 Catalyst addition, 24-hour bath life, vented continuous ovens from 80 °C, typical cure speeds and contamination precautions.
- [Peroxide-Cure Process: Benzoyl Peroxide Level, Solvent Removal and Heat Cure (Figure 6)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/peroxide-cure-process): Benzoyl peroxide at 0.5–3.0% of solids, 10% toluene solution, two-step graded cure (65–93 °C solvent removal, then 177–204 °C), and alternative tin or silane cure options.
- [Oven Dusting, Anchorage Primers and Release (Syl-Off Q2-7785)](https://kconstrade.com/en/technical/psa/oven-dusting-anchorage-release): How to reduce oven dusting from volatile silicone, improve anchorage to PET/Kapton/Teflon with primers or 0.25–0.5% Z-6020 silane, and the Syl-Off Q2-7785 fluorosilicone release coating and its applications.

## Civil Engineering
Expansion and pavement joints for roads, bridges and concrete

- [DOWSIL™ 902 RCS](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-902-rcs): Rapid-cure, self-leveling two-part sealant for bridge and highway expansion joints. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-902-rcs.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 888](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-888): One-part non-sag sealant for concrete pavement joints. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-888.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 890-SL](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-890-sl): Self-leveling road joint sealant — no tooling required. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-890-sl.pdf)

## Insulating Glass
Primary / secondary IG sealing and structural bonding

- [DOWSIL™ 335 Butyl](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-335): Polyisobutylene butyl for primary sealing of insulating glass. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-335.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 939](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-939): Two-part secondary sealant for residential insulating glass. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-939.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 982](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-982): Two-part IG secondary sealant with structural capability. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-982.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 983](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-983): Two-part structural sealant for factory glazing and curtain wall production. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-983.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 993](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-993): Two-part structural sealant meeting European (EOTA) and Chinese GB standards. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-993.pdf)

## Specialty
High-temperature, fire-stop, coatings, preformed seals and glass embedding

- [DOWSIL™ FIRESTOP 700](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-firestop-700): Fire-rated silicone for linear joints and penetration seals. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-firestop-700.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ Hi-Temp](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-rtv-hi-temp): High-temperature acetoxy silicone, continuous up to 260°C. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-rtv-hi-temp.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ ALLGUARD](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-allguard): Water-based silicone waterproof coating for exterior masonry and concrete. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-allguard.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 123](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-123): High-movement preformed silicone seal for repair and remediation. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-123.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 375](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-375): Two-part polyurethane embedding compound for glass balustrade U-profiles. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-375.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 650+](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-650-plus): Peelable protective coating for façade glass and metal. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-650-plus.pdf)

## Primers
Adhesion-promoting primers

- [DOWSIL™ Primer-C](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-primer-c): Silane primer for PVF2 (Kynar) and polyester powder-coated surfaces. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-primer-c.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ ALLGUARD Primer](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-allguard-primer): Water-based silicone adhesion promoter for ALLGUARD coating. [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-allguard-primer.pdf)
- [DOWSIL™ 1200 OS](https://kconstrade.com/en/products/dowsil-1200-os): DOWSIL™ 1200 OS Primer (LEED letter). [TDS PDF](https://kconstrade.com/tds/dowsil-1200-os.pdf)

## Notes
- Product data is summarized from Dow Technical Data Sheets (TDS); the linked PDFs are authoritative. Values are typical properties, not specifications.
- Structural glazing applications require review by Dow technical staff.
